periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis of the eye patches is oriented at approximately a 45-degree angle, slanting downwards towards the nasal bridge.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: The eye patches exhibit a sub-circular morphology with a slight vertical elongation, approximately a 1.1:1 height-to-width ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: The patches display a rounded inferior border with negligible downward tapering.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: The posterior boundary of the dorsal band displays a broad, shallow U-shaped curvature across the spinal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band occupies approximately 25-30% of the visible torso length between the neck and the mid-back.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are set widely apart on the cranial vault, with a separation distance roughly equivalent to three times the width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior boundaries of the pinnae exhibit a smooth, highly convex semicircular curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: The white dorsal fur exhibits a distinct yellowish-brown tint compared to the brighter white fur on the face.
